podcasts.name: Joel Osteen Podcast
podcasts.script: Looking for a night out the whole family can share? Clean Slate Family Comedy Night is an all-ages stand-up show at The Tabernacle in Atlanta on Friday, November 27. It's warm, clean humor, the kind you can laugh at with your kids and your parents in the same row. If you love Cedric the Entertainer, Steve Harvey or Tyler Perry, this one's for you. Get your tickets at {link}.

podcasts.name: Good Words with Kirk Franklin
podcasts.script: Atlanta, here's some good news for family night. Clean Slate Family Comedy Night brings all-ages stand-up to The Tabernacle on Friday, November 27. Clean jokes, warm laughs, and nothing you'll have to cover little ears for. If Cedric the Entertainer, Steve Harvey and Tyler Perry make you smile, bring the whole crew. Tickets are at {link}.

partners.subject: Host a family comedy pop-up at Community Grounds?
partners.body: Hi Community Grounds Cafe team! We're putting on Clean Slate Family Comedy Night, an all-ages, clean stand-up show at The Tabernacle on Friday, November 27. Our taste data shows your visitors closely match people who love Tyler Perry (0.84 affinity), so your crowd feels like a natural fit. Would you be open to hosting a small pop-up at the cafe in the weeks before the show to share flyers and tell people about it? In return we can offer [your offer, e.g. two family tickets to the show]. Details are here: {link}. Thanks for considering it!
